estonia.title: Rescue chief: Estonia short of more than 100 firefighters as pay lags
estonia.description: Estonia's rescue service needs around 100 more personnel, its deputy director has said, warning pay remains too low and the shortfall threatens response capacity.

estonia.title: Conversation cards 'Tales in Your Back Pocket' picked as Estonia's best museum souvenir
estonia.description: The Estonian Museum Association announced the winners of the 2026 EMMA Estonian Museum Souvenir Awards at the Estonian National Museum on September 28.

estonia.title: Estonia lowers apartment building renovation support share
estonia.description: While government support for apartment building renovations has so far covered 30 to 50 percent of renovation costs, in the coming years the government will cover just 20 percent.

estonia.title: Rae detention center pressure exposes gaps in state migration response
estonia.description: The extra burden on Rae municipality caused by migration pressure may become a symbol of the state's inability to cope with illegal migration, migration expert Kert Valdaru said.

estonia.title: Alar Karis embarks on farewell whistle-stop tour of neighboring countries
estonia.description: President Alar Karis has set off on a round of official visits to Estonia's nearest neighboring allied countries ahead of leaving office next month.

estonia.title: ISS director: We have prevented 'significant' number of Russian attacks
estonia.description: The Internal Security Service (ISS) has headed off a significant number of Russian-planned hybrid attacks inside Estonia in recent years, the authority's director general said.

estonia.title: Gas expert says Europe will avoid 2022‑level crisis this winter
estonia.description: Although Europe's gas storage levels are at their lowest since 2012, filling them cannot be a goal in itself because gas also arrives through LNG terminals, Baltic Energy Partners board member Marko Allikson said. He eased concerns and said that Europe will not face a gas crisis like the one in 2022 this coming winter.

estonia.title: Independents Meelis Kiili and Leo Kunnas to run on Center Party ticket in March elections
estonia.description: Meelis Kiili said shared views on security and societal development played an important role in the decision.

estonia.title: Social minister butts heads with doctors over doctor-patient confidentiality
estonia.description: The Estonian Medical Association has sent an open letter to Social Affairs Minister Karmen Joller (Reform), raising concerns that police and other state agencies can access patient records.

estonia.title: Royal Navy chief: JEF to create new combat units and get UK nuclear deterrence
estonia.description: The Joint Expeditionary Force (JEF), established to strengthen the security of 10 countries in the Nordic and Baltic region, will form new combat units centered on British military capabilities and nuclear deterrence, Royal Navy chief Gwyn Jenkins said.

estonia.title: Estonian government needs opposition votes to pass the 2027 budget
estonia.description: For the first time in years, the government needs opposition support in the Riigikogu to pass the state budget, which means taking the latter's demands into account.

estonia.title: Lääneranna Municipality seeks referendum to join a different county
estonia.description: Lääneranna Municipality has asked Estonia's election service whether it can hold a public poll on joining Lääne County alongside the next local elections.

estonia.title: Tallinn mural plan backfires as graffiti artists tag over works
estonia.description: While Tallinn is utilizing city-commissioned murals to reduce graffiti, street artists have responded by painting over them. The university town of Tartu takes a more conciliatory approach.

estonia.title: Eesti 200 and Greens consider merger ahead of 2027 vote
estonia.description: Riigikogu party Eesti 200 and the Estonian Greens (Rohelised) are considering a merger ahead of the March 2027 Riigikogu election, Eesti Ekspress reported.

estonia.title: Minister proposes removing state protection from Soviet-era buildings
estonia.description: Justice Minister Liisa-Ly Pakosta (Eesti 200) has proposed allowing buildings bearing occupation symbols erected between 1940 and 1991 to be removed from state heritage protection.

estonia.title: Kristen Michal: The government's budget is both prudent and responsible
estonia.description: Estonia's 2027 budget will reduce the deficit while investing in defense, economic growth, technology, infrastructure and health, Prime Minister Kristen Michal said in a political statement.

estonia.title: Gallery: Major Tallinn Prisma store becomes Coop Peremarket
estonia.description: The merger of the Coop and Prisma retail chains reached a milestone in Tallinn on Tuesday when Sikupilli Prisma became Coop Peremarket, the first Prisma hypermarket to join Coop's store network.

estonia.title: Estonia summons Russian chargé d'affaires over defense firm sabotage
estonia.description: Estonia's Foreign Ministry summoned the Russian chargé d'affaires on Monday to condemn the arson attack on defense company Milrem Robotics.

estonia.title: Publisher: AI will come for translators and illustrators first
estonia.description: Publishing house Tänapäev's editor-in-chief told ERR that original manuscripts written with AI remain rare, but the technology has already made its way into translation and illustration.

estonia.title: All Estonian ministries saw wage hikes in the past year
estonia.description: Average pay rose at every Estonian ministry over the past year, with the largest increases at the regional affairs and culture ministries. Pay grew slowest at the education and justice ministries.

estonia.title: Isamaa head: The state budget one of continued chaos
estonia.description: Opposition Isamaa leader Urmas Reinsalu called the coalition's 2027 budget a continuation of chaos. He said the next government must revise is to cut public sector spending.

estonia.title: Supreme Court: Publishing expunged conviction details partly unconstitutional
estonia.description: Estonia's Supreme Court has ruled that indefinitely publishing certain expunged drug and arson convictions is unconstitutional, meaning the Riigikogu will have to revisit the legislation.

estonia.title: PM: Estonia will monitor neighboring countries' fuel excise decisions
estonia.description: Prime Minister Kristen Michal says Estonia is watching its neighbors' fuel tax cuts but cannot afford further relief while trying to reduce its budget deficit.

estonia.title: New Defense Minister Martin Herem shoots to top of most popular ministers ranking
estonia.description: Of Estonia's government ministers, residents trust new Defense Minister Martin Herem by far the most, followed at a considerable distance by Culture Minister Heidy Purga and Social Affairs Minister Karmen Joller.

estonia.title: WSJ: Estonian tech guru 'terrified' of AI yet set to make billions
estonia.description: Estonian tech billionaire Jaan Tallinn had long warned of the risks of rapid Artificial Intelligence (AI) development, the Wall Street Journal reported.

estonia.title: ISS chief: Milrem arson was first successful Russian attack on Estonia this year
estonia.description: The arson attack on the Milrem building was the first successful attack in Estonia this year carried out on behalf of Russian special services, Internal Security Service (ISS) chief Margo Palloson has said.

estonia.title: Migration pressure clogs administrative courts, delaying other cases
estonia.description: Migratory pressure is putting such a burden on the Estonian court system that it has been delaying other proceedings.

estonia.title: Expert: Russia clearly has the upper hand in the air in Ukraine
estonia.description: Ukraine faces a difficult winter as Russian air attacks intensify and shortages of Patriot interceptor missiles leave it struggling to protect civilian infrastructure, Marko Mihkelson tells ERR in an interview.

estonia.title: Minister: Ukraine gets €6.6bn in EU support to boost combat power
estonia.description: Defense Minister Martin Herem (Reform) welcomed the European Union's €6.6 billion aid package to Ukraine, calling it "a powerful step forward" in aid.

estonia.title: SDE deputy chair: Government's tax break for the well-to-do root of state budget woes
estonia.description: Social Democratic Party Deputy Chair Riina Sikkut said abolishing Estonia's income "tax hump" was the root of the budget's problems, tying the government's hands.

estonia.title: Estonia: Russia responsible for arson attack on defense contractor Milrem
estonia.description: Based on ISS intelligence, there are grounds to state with full confidence that the arson attack on the Milrem building in Tallinn on August 15 was an act of sabotage commissioned by Russian special services, the government said in a press release.

estonia.title: Tallinn-Tartu train timetable change postponed to November 2
estonia.description: Elron's September schedule change cut Southern Estonia's morning rail link to Tallinn, with Elva passengers facing a 45-minute Tartu transfer and a journey of nearly four hours.

estonia.title: Meelis Oidsalu: President's title of 'supreme commander of national defense' misleading
estonia.description: President-elect Ülle Madise wants the National Defense Council to meet more regularly, raising questions about how she will use the presidency's largely symbolic role in defense policy.

estonia.title: Estonia's special care funding falls 5 times short of sector's expectations
estonia.description: The government plans to allocate far less state funding to specialized care in the coming years than the sector sought. The Estonian Chamber of Disabled People says even that amount is welcome.

estonia.title: 'Time travel' takes Estonian schoolchildren to the 1936 Berlin Olympics
estonia.description: For nearly a decade, Estonian schools have been using the Time Travel method to bring history to life.

estonia.title: Media executives: Foreign-language dubbing ban harms economy, security
estonia.description: ERR and private media outlets in Estonia have called for a reversal of the ban on foreign-language dubbing.

estonia.title: Gallery: Estonia marks 32 years from the Estonia ferry disaster
estonia.description: Monday marked 32 years since the sinking of the Estonia ferry. A memorial service and wreath laying were held at the disaster's monument in Tallinn.

estonia.title: Study: Going to the theater a chance to develop self-empathy
estonia.description: University of Tartu doctoral student Merilin Jürjo studied what happens in our minds during a theater performance and why some productions resonate with us while others do not.

estonia.title: Scabies spreading in Estonia again
estonia.description: Doctors and nurses warn that the disease spreads easily and urge those infected to complete treatment.

estonia.title: Estonian actors protest onslaught of artificial intelligence in new EU rules
estonia.description: The Estonian Actors' Union is concerned that proposed EU changes to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) would make it easier for AI to use actors' voices and likenesses.

estonia.title: Estonia's women finish 42nd, men 66th at Chess Olympiad
estonia.description: Estonia's women's team finished 42nd and the men's team 66th as the 46th Chess Olympiad concluded in Samarkand, Uzbekistan on Sunday.

estonia.title: €14 million cut from road funding for 2027, delaying project completion
estonia.description: The completion of some road maintenance projects due for 2027 will be delayed, Infrastructure Minister Kuldar Leis (Reform) said.

estonia.title: Estonia's R&D funding might not hit agreed-upon 1% of GDP next year
estonia.description: Under an agreement reached years ago, the state is to spend at least 1 percent of GDP on research and development. However, funding may fall short of that target in the coming years.

estonia.title: Harles Tammeleht: Business tourism could help Tallinn hotels survive the winter
estonia.description: A conference center at Tallinn's Linnahall could bring visitors during the low season and help hotels and restaurants operate year-round, writes Harles Tammeleht.

estonia.title: French hosts strip Estonia of quadcross 3rd place, hand it to France
estonia.description: The FIM SidecarCross & QuadCross and of Nations round in Dardon-Gueugnon, France, ended in a major setback for Estonia as the team was stripped of third place.

estonia.title: Estonia prioritizes national defense, postpones Rail Baltica completion in 2027 budget
estonia.description: Next year's state budget projects €20.2 billion in spending and €19.4 billion in revenue. The deficit is forecast at 4 percent of GDP.

estonia.title: Estonian kids increasingly experience fear of school
estonia.description: In recent years, the number of students who find going to school extremely frightening or unpleasant has grown.

estonia.title: Expert: Ukraine's recent success an operational-level breakthrough
estonia.description: Ukraine's successful offensive near Lyman has achieved an operational breakthrough that could be repeated elsewhere, Maj. Gen. (Ret.) Neeme Väli told ERR.

estonia.title: Minister: Trump-Zelenskyy UN encounter did not bring peace any closer
estonia.description: US President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's recent meeting did little to advance the Ukraine peace process, Foreign Minister Tsahkna (Eesti 200) said.

estonia.title: 7-year sentence handed down to Oleg Bessedin for anti-Estonia activities
estonia.description: A court has found a pro-Kremlin propagandist guilty of crimes against Estonia's independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity.

estonia.title: USA armee asus testima soomustatud humanoidrobotit
estonia.description: USA maavägi valis 103 esitatud idee seast välja viis humanoidrobotite arendusega seotud tehnoloogiat, mida hakatakse edasi katsetama. Neist kõige tähelepanuväärsem on inimese kehakujuga robot Alex, mille on välja töötanud Florida Institute for Human and Machine Cognition (IHMC).

estonia.title: Saksa teadlaste abil jõudis betoonidieet ehitusse: uus vahelagi saab hakkama kolmandikuga betoonikogusest
estonia.description: Stuttgarti ülikooli teadlased töötasid välja puidupõhise vahelaesüsteemi UniversalTimberSlab, mis vajab raudbetooniga võrreldes kolmandiku jagu vähem betooni, kuid pakub samaväärset tugevust. Õhuke ja punkttoetusega hübriidkonstruktsioon kaotab vajaduse kandvate vaheseinte järele, suurendab ruumiplaneeringu paindlikkust ning vähendab märgatavalt ehituse süsiniku jalajälge.

estonia.title: Ladies’ Night – mood ja hobused ühes suurejoonelises etenduses
estonia.description: Reede õhtu toob Tallinn International Horse Show areenile tänavuse ühe erilisema etteaste. Ladies’ Night’i keskmes on Riina Laanetu moeetendus, kus koos modellidega astuvad areenile ka «tantsivad hobused». Mood, muusika ja hobuste liikumine ühendatakse terviklikuks vaatemänguks, mis on loodud just suurele areenile.

estonia.title: «Sinu raamatul on rahvusvahelist potentsiaali!» Eesti kirjanikke on tabanud petukirjade laine
estonia.description: Eesti kirjanike postkaste on viimasel ajal hakanud ummistama kirjad inimestelt, kes esitlevad end välismaiste kirjandusagentide, raamatuturundajate või isegi tuntud meediaväljaannete esindajatena. Pakkumised on ahvatlevad: sinu raamat on suurepärane, sellel on rahvusvahelist potentsiaali ja meie aitame selle välismaa lugejateni viia.

estonia.title: Tõekomisjon soovitab Rootsi riigil paluda saamidelt ajaloolise ülekohtu eest vabandust
estonia.description: Rootsi riigi poolt saami põlisrahva vastu toime pandud ebaõigluse uurimiseks loodud tõekomisjon on jõudnud järeldusele, et riik kannab toimunu eest vastutust ja peaks ajaloolise ülekohtu eest ametlikult vabandust paluma.

estonia.title: Riik ootab intressi- ja omanikutulu vähenemist
estonia.description: Tuleva aasta riigieelarves on intressi- ja omanikutuluks ette nähtud 235,3 miljonit eurot. Aastaga väheneks see tulu 13,5 miljoni euro ehk 5,4 protsendi võrra.

estonia.title: Eelnõu: politseidrooni kaamerasilmale uued reeglid, eraisikud arvestagu kohustusega abistada korrakaitsjat
estonia.description: Justiits- ja digiminister Liisa Pakosta saatis valitsusele arutamiseks korrakaitseseaduse muutmise eelnõu, mis seab reeglid droonide ja muude vahenditega saadud salvestiste töötlemiseks. Samuti lubatakse asendada protokollid videoga ja riigile antakse luba küsida eraisikult välja salvestisi, kui seda on menetluse jaoks vaja.

estonia.title: GRAAFIKUD ⟩ Pärnu uusarenduste buum: müügis üle 400 korteri, nende hinnavahe mitmekordne
estonia.description: Pärnus on praegu aktiivses müügis üle 40 uusarenduse, kus kokku on umbes 400 vaba korterit. Nii tekib küsimus, kes ostavad ära uusarenduste sajad eluasemed.

estonia.title: POSTIMEHE OSTUKORV ⟩ Kalleima ostukoha tiitel rändas uuele omanikule
estonia.description: Värskest Postimehe ostukorvide hinnavõrdlusest selgub, et hinnakonkurents toidukaupluste vahel püsib tihe. Kuigi kõik ostukorvid jäävad alla 40 euro, lahutab odavaimat ja kalleimat ostukohta juba ligi viis eurot.

estonia.title: PARC FERMÉ ⟩ Sardiinia teede lõhkuv iseloom, Toyota taktikatrikk ja igavene must hobune
estonia.description: Postimehe rallisaates «Parc Fermé» arutleti eelseisva Sardiinia MM-ralli teemadel. Kes Toyota meestest tuleb maailmameistriks ning kas Hyundail on ralli võidu nimel võidelda, eriti kui nende tiimis on igavene must hobune Dani Sordo? Kui head hoogu näitavad «pingevabalt» startivad WRC2 maailmameistrid Robert Virves ja Jakko Viilo. Saatejuhid on Karl Mihkel Eller ja Kauri Pannas.

estonia.title: OKSANA BROVKO ⟩ Tänagi meenutan seda kausitäit borši... Vabaduse õppetund Ukraina kohalikelt uudistetoimetustelt
estonia.description: Venemaa rünnakus põles ära umbes 80 protsenti kohaliku Ukraina ajalehe tiraažist. Toimetus oli juba hävitatud. Ometi pidi see ajaleht ikkagi lugejateni jõudma, meenutab Ukraina sõltumatute piirkondlike pressikirjastajate liidu tegevjuht Oksana Brovko.

latvia.title: Nyílt pályázatot hirdetett a kormány az Országos Közlekedési Központ vezérigazgatói posztjára
latvia.description: Vitézy Dávid a nyáron hozott létre országos közlekedésszervezőt a BKK mintájára, ennek keresik most a vezetőjét.

latvia.title: Ruszin-Szendi Romulusz: A katonák előre jelezték, hogy ne legyen éles kézigránátos kiképzés Újdörögdnél
latvia.description: A honvédelmi miniszter szerint az elévülés miatt a felelősökkel szemben újabb büntetőeljárásra sincs lehetőség.

latvia.title: Eltűnt a hasnyálmirigyrák az mRNS immunterápia után az egerekben
latvia.description: Nemcsak hogy eltűntek a hasnyálmirigyrák daganatok a kísérleti mRNS immunterápiával kezelt egerekből, hanem még a kezelés leállítása utáni egy év múlva sem újult ki a betegség. Az amerikai kutatók fejlesztését a Covid-vakcinák terén elért eredmények ihlették.

latvia.description: Akkor egy 29 éves kormánytisztviselő sérült meg súlyosan, miután a kezében egy rossz mozdulat miatt a gránát túl hamar működésbe lépett.

latvia.title: Vitézy Dávid bejelentette, bárki jelentkezhet az új közlekedési központ élére
latvia.description: Nyílt pályázatot írtak ki.

latvia.title: Áll a bál az Eiffel-torony körül, lemondott a vezérigazgató, miután női alkalmazottak kitiltását engedélyezték
latvia.description: Mindez egy hindu csoport látogatásán történt.

latvia.title: Atomtámadással fenyegetőzik Moszkva, titkos tárgyalások folynak Amerikában - Híreink az ukrajnai háborúról szerdán
latvia.description: Lezuhant egy orosz Tu-95-ös hadászati bombázó az orosz Távol-Keleten, az incidens okait egyelőre viszgálják. Washingtoban nem bejelentett módon tárgyalnak az amerikaiak az oroszokkal, Kirill Dmitrijev főtárgyaló a városban van. Hajnalban súlyos támadás érte Kijevet: az ukrán főváros lángokban áll. A nap folyamán Oroszország arról kezdett el kommunikálni, hogy Európa blokádolni akarja Kalinyingrádot, így atomtámadással is megfenyegették a NATO európai országait. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború szerdai eseményeivel.

latvia.title: Bedurvultak az oroszok: ha Európa ezt tényleg megteszi, Moszkva indítja az atomfegyvereket
latvia.description: Nukleáris fegyverekkel fog csapást mérni Oroszország, ha a NATO megpróbálja blokád alá vonni Kalinyingrádot – közölte Oroszország dublini nagykövetsége a Kyiv Independent cikke szerint.

latvia.title: Bemondta az európai vezető: a NATO-nak minél hamarabb ukrán fegyverekre van szüksége
latvia.description: Belgium számára az orosz légitámadások jelentik a legnagyobb biztonsági fenyegetést, ezért meg kell erősíteni a légvédelmi képességeket - jelentette ki Theo Francken belga védelmi miniszter szerdán Brüsszelben.

latvia.title: Orosz támadás veszélye miatt leállítottak két NATO-repteret
latvia.description: Átmenetileg leállították a forgalmat szerda reggel a lengyelországi Lublin és Rzeszów repülőterén a lengyel légierő műveletei miatt - közölte az X-en a lengyel légi közlekedési hatóság (PANSA).

latvia.title: Na pomoc Pobaltí bychom v případě napadení museli vyslat dvě brigády, řekl Babiš
latvia.description: Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) se v úterý po uložení korunovačních klenotů setkal s prezidentem Petrem Pavlem. Předseda vlády serveru Deník.cz řekl, že s hlavou státu diskutoval o programu příští Bezpečnostní rady státu, včetně možné reakce na případný ruský útok na některý z pobaltských států. „Pokud by nedej bože došlo k tomu, že by Rusko napadlo nějaký pobaltský stát, tak podle článku pět (NATO) musíme vyslat dvě naše mechanizované brigády,“ sdělil premiér.

latvia.title: Senát schválil nižší počet vojáků bránící východní křídlo NATO
latvia.description: Na obranu východního křídla NATO bude moci být v příštích dvou letech vysláno nejvýše 1600 českých vojáků, o 400 méně než dosud, schválil Senát. Horní komora parlamentu také na úvod svého středečního jednání vyslovila souhlas s ratifikací Úmluvy o zřízení Mezinárodní komise pro posuzování nároků Ukrajiny. Dále má na programu senátorské návrhy o nepromlčitelnosti trestného činu vraždy, o daňové úlevě pro dobrovolné hasiče a o ústavním zakotvení práva na život off-line.

latvia.title: Estonsko obvinilo Rusko ze žhářského útoku na zbrojní firmu
latvia.description: Estonsko uvedlo, že srpnový požár v tallinském zbrojním podniku Milrem Robotics byl způsoben žhářským útokem provedeným na rozkaz ruských tajných služeb. Informovala o tom stanice ERR. Firma dodává Ruskem napadené Ukrajině pozemní drony. Moskva podíl na požáru popřela. Generální tajemník NATO Mark Rutte prohlásil, že ruské hybridní útoky proti aliančním zemím neoslabí podporu Ukrajině.

latvia.title: Un zbor Dubai-Tel Aviv a aterizat în Arabia Saudită după o alertă de deturnare. Oficial israelian: „Un pilot l-a înjunghiat pe altul”
latvia.description: Un zbor Flydubai de la Dubai la Tel Aviv, cu 174 de pasageri la bord, dintre care 27 de copii, a aterizat miercuri în Arabia Saudită după ce o altercație fizică între piloți a declanșat un semnal de urgență care a stârnit inițial temeri privind o deturnare și a determinat Israelul să mobilizeze avioane de vânătoare, relatează ynetnews.com.

latvia.title: Moscova a avertizat oficial NATO că va folosi armele nucleare dacă Alianța va încerca să izoleze o exclavă rusă
latvia.description: Kremlinul a confirmat miercuri că Rusia a transmis avertismente de natură nucleară către NATO prin care atenţionează Alianţa cu privire la riscurile unei eventuale încercări de izolare a exclavei ruse Kaliningrad, pentru a le reaminti astfel „capetelor înfierbântate" din Europa dispoziţiile politicii Moscovei în cazul unor acţiuni de acest fel, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: Petrișor Peiu: Orice sprijin pentru Ucraina trebuie condiționat. Sancțiunile asupra Rusiei sunt consecința etichetării ca stat agresor
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, a declarat miercuri, în direct la Digi24, că „orice sprijin trebuie să fie condiționat” în cazul Ucrainei și că partidul consideră Rusia „un stat agresor”. Peiu a precizat că AUR „nu își propune să schimbe aranjamentele internaționale ale României”.

latvia.title: Cehia susține că ar fi gata să-și onoreze angajamentele față de NATO dacă Rusia atacă o țară baltică: „Desigur că ne pregătim”
latvia.description: Republica Cehă ar fi pregătită să-și onoreze angajamentele față de NATO în cazul unui atac al Rusiei asupra unei țări baltice, a declarat marți prim-ministrul Andrej Babis pentru un site de știri ceh, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: Rusia amenință Europa cu atacuri nucleare. În ce situație va folosi țara lui Putin focoasele strategice
latvia.description: Rusia va recurge la toate mijloacele de care dispune, inclusiv cele nucleare, în cazul în care țările NATO vor încerca să blocheze regiunea Kaliningrad sau să o atace, a declarat Ambasada Federației Ruse în Marea Britanie.

latvia.title: Tensiuni explozive la granița NATO. Alianța militară respinge avertismentul Rusiei privind Kaliningrad și promite autoapărare totală
latvia.description: NATO a respins, marţi, cu fermitate, un avertisment venit din partea Moscovei privind o escaladare militară serioasă în jurul exclavei ruse Kaliningrad, informează DPA.

latvia.title: Rutte: Rusia nu poate sparge unitatea NATO. Cum răspunde Alianța la atacurile cu drone și sabotajele hibride
latvia.description: Rutte a afirmat că Rusia nu a reușit să zdruncine unitatea NATO, în ciuda actelor de sabotaj și a atacurilor cu drone. Alianța își consolidează apărarea și sprijinul acordat Ucrainei.

latvia.title: CCR a decis că femeile asigurate pe cont propriu nu pot fi excluse de la concediul și indemnizația de risc maternal
latvia.description: Curtea Constituțională a decis marți, cu unanimitate de voturi, că femeile asigurate pe cont propriu, printr-un contract încheiat cu casa de sănătate, nu pot fi excluse de la concediul și indemnizația de risc maternal doar pentru că nu au statutul de salariate. Judecătorii au stabilit că această diferență de tratament este discriminatorie și încalcă dreptul la ocrotirea sănătății și la un nivel de trai decent.

latvia.title: Viceguvernator BNR: „Prelungirea crizei politice devine tot mai problematică. Revenirea la normalitate este esențială”
latvia.description: România înregistrează „semne bune” în reducerea dezechilibrelor bugetare, progrese observate și de agențiile de rating, însă prelungirea crizei politice pune tot mai multe probleme, avertizează viceguvernatorul BNR Cosmin Marinescu. Acesta spune că revenirea la normalitate în planul guvernării este esențială pentru încrederea investitorilor și a mediului de afaceri.

latvia.title: O dronă rusă a avariat un punct de frontieră ucrainean de la graniţa cu Polonia. Vămi închise temporar
latvia.description: O dronă rusă cu motor cu reacţie a lovit luni satul ucrainean Starovoitove, situat lângă graniţa cu Polonia, avariind un punct de control la frontieră, a anunţat guvernatorul interimar al regiunii Volînia.

latvia.title: „Al treilea sezon” al operațiunii „Vivaldi”. Ucraina anunță noi câștiguri în Donețk și peste 2.000 de pierderi în rândul rușilor
latvia.description: Forțele ucrainene aflate sub comanda Corpului 3 de Armată au eliberat alte trei sate din nordul regiunii Donețk, în cadrul operațiunii „Vivaldi”, aflată în desfășurare, a declarat comandantul corpului, generalul de brigadă Andrii Bilețki, relatează Kyiv Independent.

latvia.title: Darryl Nirenberg, vizită la poligonul de instrucție Babadag: „România nu este singură. Statele Unite sunt aici și NATO este aici”
latvia.description: Prezent la Babadag cu ocazia sosirii primelor vehicule amfibii de asalt AAV-7, ambasadorul Statelor Unite ale Americii în România, Darryl Nirenberg, a susținut că aceste vehicule sunt importante, dar și impresionante. Diplomatul este de părere că sosirea acestora reprezintă „un exemplu foarte bun” al parteneriatului dintre SUA și România, care va împlini anul viitor 30 de ani.

latvia.title: Generalul NATO Alexus Grynkewich: De ce vrea Rusia să slăbească voința aliaților Ucrainei și ce riscă Europa
latvia.description: Comandantul suprem al forţelor aliate în Europa (SACEUR), Alexus Grynkewich, le-a transmis luni eurodeputaţilor că obiectivul Moscovei este de a înfrânge dorinţa aliaţilor Ucrainei de a continua să sprijine această ţară în războiul său de apărare contra Rusiei, transmite Reuters.

latvia.title: Proiectul privind alegerile anticipate, pus în dezbatere: se reduc unele termene şi numărul minim de susţinători necesar candidaților
latvia.description: Autoritatea Electorală Permanentă (AEP) anunţă că proiectul de lege privind alegerile anticipate a fost pus în transparenţă. Instituția subliniază că proiectul nu pune în discuție posibilitatea organizării unui astfel de scrutin, ci urmărește ca, în eventualitatea în care acesta ar avea loc, procesul electoral să se desfășoare cu respectarea deplină a Constituției și a garanțiilor pe care legea le oferă fiecărui alegător, oriunde s-ar afla.

latvia.title: Reacția Kremlinului după ce s-a aflat că a amenințat NATO cu folosirea armelor nucleare
latvia.description: Kremlinul a confirmat miercuri că Moscova a avertizat NATO într-un document că ar putea recurge la folosirea arsenalului său nuclear, purtătorul de cuvânt al președintelui Vladimir Putin afirmând că o astfel de mutare este „absolut firească”, transmite agenția Reuters, citată de Agerpres. Într-un document dezvăluit în premieră miercuri de agenția Reuters, Moscova a avertizat NATO …

latvia.title: Planul Europei de a se reînarma, criticat din nou de SUA: „Suntem mai puternici atunci când lucrăm împreună”
latvia.description: Presiunea de a introduce prevederi de tipul „Made în Europa” în inițiativele de reînarmare riscă să îndepărteze aliații din NATO și să afecteze securitatea colectivă, a declarat miercuri Andrew Puzder, ambasadorul Statelor Unite pe lângă Uniunea Europeană, relatează Euronews. „Atunci când viețile oamenilor sunt în joc, capacitatea și disponibilitatea ar trebui să determine soluția, nu …

latvia.title: Rusia a transmis NATO într-un document un scenariu în care își va folosi armele nucleare: „Este pentru prima dată de la încheierea Războiului Rece când ne amenință în acest fel”
latvia.description: Rusia a avertizat NATO că ar fi pregătită să recurgă la folosirea arsenalului său nuclear dacă Alianța Nord-Atlantică ar încerca să izoleze Kaliningradul, o exclavă rusă de la Marea Baltică. Într-un document transmis NATO și obținut de agenția Reuters, Moscova a acuzat alianța de o „conduită periculoasă și imprudentă”, despre care Moscova susține că presupune …

latvia.title: Senatul spaniol a respins ratificarea tratatului de prietenie cu Franţa în timp ce Emmanuel Macron efectuează o vizită de stat la Madrid
latvia.description: Senatul spaniol, dominat de opoziţia de dreapta, a respins marţi seară ratificarea tratatului de prietenie dintre Spania şi Franţa, în plină vizită de stat a preşedintelui Emmanuel Macron la Madrid, notează agenția de știri AFP, citată de Agerpres. În detaliu, 142 de senatori de dreapta (Partidul Popular, PP) şi de extremă-dreapta (Vox) au votat împotriva […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: OKSANA BROVKO ⟩ Tänagi meenutan seda kausitäit borši... Vabaduse õppetund Ukraina kohalikelt uudistetoimetustelt
latvia.description: Venemaa rünnakus põles ära umbes 80 protsenti kohaliku Ukraina ajalehe tiraažist. Toimetus oli juba hävitatud. Ometi pidi see ajaleht ikkagi lugejateni jõudma, meenutab Ukraina sõltumatute piirkondlike pressikirjastajate liidu tegevjuht Oksana Brovko.

latvia.title: Forty dogs removed from cruel conditions in Latvia
latvia.description: The Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) in Dundaga has rescued more than 40 dogs that were being kept in cramped, unsuitable outdoor cages without proper care; some of the dogs were also severely emaciated. All the dogs will be taken to animal shelters.

latvia.title: Drunk-driving Uzulnieks could face up to a year in prison
latvia.description: Reinis Uzulnieks, the former Minister for Welfare, who was caught driving whilst heavily intoxicated and has since been expelled from his party, has been accused under Section 262(1.1) of the Criminal Law for driving with a blood alcohol level of at least 1.5 per mille, Latvian Television reports on September 30.

latvia.title: Majority of young Latvians live in overcrowded homes
latvia.description: New Eurostat data show that a majority of young Latvians live in homes that are classed as "overcrowded".

latvia.title: Two youths rob shooting range in Daugavpils, Latvia
latvia.description: Two young men have been arrested in Daugavpils after stealing firearms from the premises of the Daugavpils shooting range on Sunday, 27 September. The State Police have launched a criminal investigation.

latvia.title: Non-cash payments at an all-time high in Latvia
latvia.description: The proportion of cashless payments in Latvia has reached a record high. In August this year, cashless payments accounted for 81 per cent of transactions, while cash payments made up 19 per cent, according to the latest – autumn 2026 – edition of the Bank of Latvia’s ‘Payment Radar’.

latvia.title: Denniss Cirkins adds some star quality to Latvian football
latvia.description: A new player has pulled on the coveted jersey of the Latvian national football team, making his home debut for the national team on September 28th after a long and rather complicated journey.

latvia.title: 'Arsenāls' exhibition hall in Rīga to be renovated
latvia.description: In order to complete the refurbishment projects for the Great Guild Hall and the ‘Arsenāls’ exhibition hall, the Cabinet of Ministers (MK) decided, at its meeting on 29 September, to support the proposal put forward by the Ministry of Culture (MC) to reallocate flexibility funding from the European Regional Development Fund, amounting to 4,350,933 euros.

latvia.title: Britain pledges nuclear deterrent to defence of Baltic
latvia.description: In response to potential Russian threats, Britain has committed to providing nuclear protection to the members of the Joint Response Force (JRF), including the Baltic states, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Saeima set to okay fuel tax cut in final pre-election session
latvia.description: In its final session before nationwide elections, the Latvian parliament is set to approve cuts to the cost of transport fuel.

latvia.title: CERT: Repeated attacks on municipal surveillance systems in Latvia
latvia.description: Recently, there have been repeated attacks on surveillance systems, cameras and smart building control systems in several regions of Latvia, Varis Teivāns, deputy head of the cyber incident response agency ‘Cert.lv’, said in an interview on the Latvian Television programme ‘Morning Panorama’ on September 30.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 29th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Big growth in aggressor state grain transit via Latvia
latvia.description: Between September 1st and 24th, more than 253 thousand tonnes of grain were transported in transit through Latvia from Russia, and more than 40 thousand tonnes of grain from Belarus, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Extra 10 million allocated to Latvian hospitals
latvia.description: The government on Tuesday approved the allocation of an additional 10 million euros to hospitals from the budget programme ‘Funds for unforeseen circumstances’.

latvia.title: Retail trade experienced uptick in August in Latvia
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) data published on September 29, retail trade turnover in August 2026 was 3.5 % higher than a year ago (calendar-adjusted data at constant prices).

latvia.title: First two days of advance voting show fairly good turnout in Latvia
latvia.description: During the first two days, around 38,600 people took the opportunity to cast their vote in advance of the 15th Saeima elections, whilst nearly 5,000 more citizens have applied to vote by post, which the Central Election Commission also counts as voter turnout, bringing the total to 2.79 per cent, according to the CVK's information on September 29.

latvia.title: Latvian Freedom Monument is being cleaned
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 29 September, work began on cleaning the Freedom Monument, carried out by SIA “Wenda Wash” on behalf of the Rīga Monuments Agency, the Rīga City Council announced.

latvia.title: Rīga film fest shorts test screening slots confirmed
latvia.description: 'SHORT RIGA Test Screenings', the longest-running section of the Riga International Film Festival (15–25 October) industry programme RIGA IFF FORUM, has announced its lineup for this year's edition.

latvia.title: 'Blue Flag' swimming season considered a success in Rīga
latvia.description: Riga's 'Blue Flag' swimming areas have received a positive assessment from the Environmental Education Foundation and the National Jury of the Blue Flag Programme for the 2026 season, according to a release from Rīga city council.

latvia.title: Latvia a hotspot for fatal workplace accidents
latvia.description: Latvia's rate of fatal accidents at work is considerably higher than the European Union average, according to fresh Eurostat data.

latvia.title: Badger vs. hedgehog brawl results in police action in Aizpute, Latvia
latvia.description: On the night of Saturday, 26 September, the South Kurzeme District Municipal Police received an unusual call from Aizpute, where the residents of a block of flats had had their night’s sleep disturbed by a brawl that had broken out between a hedgehog and a badger, reports the website “liepajniekiem.lv”.

latvia.title: Memorial for first Latvian female MP unveiled in Rīga
latvia.description: On Monday, 28 September, on the birthday of Berta Pīpiņa – the first woman elected to the Saeima and a prominent interwar politician – a commemorative plaque dedicated to her and her husband Ērmanis Pīpiņš-Vizulis was unveiled in Rīga on Ģertrūdes Street, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Latvia and Cyprus play out goalless draw
latvia.description: Neither hosts Latvia nor visitors Cyprus were abe to find the back of the net in their Nations League encounter in Rīga on Monday night.

latvia.title: Around 26,000 cast their vote on Monday in Latvia
latvia.description: On Monday, September 28th, around 26,000 voters took advantage of the opportunity to vote early and deposit their ballots ahead of the main parliamentary election day on Saturday, October 3rd.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 28th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia v Cyprus international football
latvia.description: Following a 2-0 loss away to Armenia over the weekend, Latvia will hope to get its Nations League campaign up and running properly at home with a match against Cyprus on Monday night.

latvia.title: Convicted money-launderer among investors in Rīga property scheme
latvia.description: A Syrian citizen living in Dubai has become one of the investors in the large-scale real estate project dubbed "Riga Waterfront". However, a few years ago, he was convicted in Denmark in a large-scale money laundering case, LTV's De Facto investigative programme reported on September 27th as part of an investigation carried out in cooperation with the European Broadcast union (EBU) investigative journalism network.

latvia.title: Disgraced drunk-driving former minister not ready to give up politics
latvia.description: If voters elect former Welfare Minister Reinis Uzulnieks to the Saeima at the weekend, he will be ready to carry on working as a member of parliament, the LETA newswire reports.

latvia.title: Latvian football stars face Monday night challenge of Cyprus
latvia.description: The Latvian national football team start the new UEFA Nations League season on September 25th away against Armenia, returning home on the wrong end of a 2:0 scoreline.

latvia.title: Murky water possible in some parts of Rīga this week
latvia.description: From Tuesday 29 September, from 8.00 am on Tuesday 29 September until 8.00 am on Friday 2 October, Rīga water supplier ‘Rīgas ūdens’ will be flushing an 8.5 km section of the water main from Cēsu Street to the water outlet at the Dreiliņi roundabout.

latvia.title: LISTEN AGAIN: Liepāja Symphony Orchestra's 146th season opening concert
latvia.description: Latvian Radio is delighted to bring you live coverage of the Liepāja Symphony Orchestra's season opening concert from September 19th, direct from the 'Lielais Dzintars' concert hall in Liepāja.

latvia.title: Not enough passion in Latvian politics says ex-President Zatlers
latvia.description: Pre-election campaigning for the upcoming Saeima elections lacks the passion that could stimulate voters/' interest in going to vote, former President Valdis Zatlers said on the Latvian Television programme "Morning Panorama" on September 28th.

latvia.title: Security service says it is keeping a close eye on Latvian election campaign
latvia.description: During the current pre-election period, the State Security Service (VDD) is keeping a close eye on "what is happening in society and the information space" in order to prevent attempts to illegally influence the course and results of the 15th Saeima elections, it said on September 28th.

latvia.title: Nurse gets prison sentence over medication mishap causing death
latvia.description: On Monday, 28 September, Riga City Court sentenced a nurse at the Children’s Clinical University Hospital (BKUS) to two and a half years’ imprisonment after she accidentally mixed up the medication to be administered to a patient last November, resulting in the patient’s death.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank will discuss 'new geopolitical reality' in November
latvia.description: Latvijas Banka, the Latvian central bank (LB), has released a few details of its next annual conference, which "will focus on the economic challenges the euro area is facing in the new geopolitical reality."

latvia.title: Parties pore over polls in final days of Saeima election campaign
latvia.description: With just a few days to go before Latvia's parliamentary elections on October 3rd, parties continue to jostle for position, according to the latest data from the SKDS pollster produced for Latvian Television.

latvia.title: One final week of summer in store for Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that Latvia will experience summery weather this week.

latvia.title: Latvian parliamentary candidate's education info raises questions
latvia.description: Uncertainty has arisen regarding the educational background stated by Artūrs Butāns, a Member of the Saeima for the National Alliance (NA), in the last three Saeima elections, according to information compiled by the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Early voting starts Monday for Latvian parliamentary elections
latvia.description: During the week of the 15th Saeima elections, from Monday 28 September to Friday 2 October, voters can cast their votes in advance. This can be done at any of the 933 polling stations across Latvia, according to the Central Election Commission (CVK).

latvia.title: Sunny and warm Monday in Latvia
latvia.description: Monday morning in Latvia is chilly, and foggy in many places, but the day is set to be sunny and warm, according to forecasts by Toms Bricis, LSM's weatherman.

latvia.title: Store-bought shelters a consideration for Latvia
latvia.description: To date, the main focus in establishing a network of bomb shelters in Latvia has been on identifying and adapting the basements of existing state and local authority buildings. One of the next steps involves industrially manufactured shelters. The Ministry of Economics is currently preparing standard documentation for the procurement of such shelters, Latvian Radio reported on September 28.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 27th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 25th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia has room for improvement in recognising scam e-mails
latvia.description: In the phishing simulation campaigns carried out last year by the cyber incident response organisation ‘Cert.lv’, 31.5 per cent of the 15,436 emails sent were opened, according to the 2025 report on Latvian cyber security and Cert.lv’s technical activities.

latvia.title: Four Italian soldiers injured at Ādaži military base, Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, 25 September, in the late afternoon, an incident occurred during a training exercise at the Ādaži military training area, in which four soldiers from the Italian contingent of the 11th Bersaglieri Regiment were injured, according to the National Armed Forces (NBS ).

latvia.title: Heating prices will rise in Latvia this winter
latvia.description: Latvia is ready for the heating season, but people will most likely have to pay more for heating. The Ministry of Climate and Energy (KEM) estimates that, in the event of a mild or moderately cold winter, heating costs could rise by 10 to 15 per cent, Latvian Radio reported on September 25. In some local authorities, the increase may be even greater.

latvia.title: Two arrested in connection with child porn case in Latvia
latvia.description: In connection with the involvement of a person under the age of 16 in the production of pornographic material, two people were arrested in September this year – the child’s mother, who produced the material for financial gain, and a man who used it, according to the State Police's statement on September 25.

latvia.title: Russian city names found painted over on Latvia's road signs
latvia.description: Several painted-over road signs have been spotted on the A12 motorway near Rēzekne, on which references to the Russian cities of Moscow and Ostrov have been obscured. The damaged road signs were spotted on Monday, 21 September, but it is not known exactly when they were painted over.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Symphony, Ukraine, Anatomy
latvia.description: Here comes our selection for this weekend!

latvia.title: German Eurofighter jets arrive at Lielvārde air base
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, four German Air Force ‘Eurofighter’ fighter jets arrived at the National Armed Forces’ ‘Lielvārde’ military base to temporarily reinforce the defence of Latvia’s airspace, said the Defence Ministry.

latvia.title: Some polling station staff in eastern Latvia replaced over security concerns
latvia.description: Several local authorities on the eastern border have been forced to make urgent changes to the staff at many polling stations. The State Security Service confirmed to the LSM Latgale editorial team on September 24 that a total of 6,000 polling station staff have been vetted across Latvia.

latvia.title: Šie daudzu iemīļotie pārtikas produkti var pasliktināt garastāvokli un pat iedzīt depresijā
latvia.description: Stress, trauksme un depresija var būtiski ietekmēt cilvēka ikdienu. Lai uzlabotu pašsajūtu, cilvēki nereti pievērš uzmanību arī uzturam. Serotonīns ir svarīgs neiromediators, kas iesaistīts garastāvokļa, miega, atmiņas un vairāku citu organisma funkciju regulēšanā. Speciālisti norāda, ka daži pārtikas produkti, īpaši tad, ja tos lieto lielos daudzumos un regulāri, var nebūt labvēlīgi ne pašsajūtai, ne uzturam […]

latvia.title: Āboli pūst pirms tie ir nogatavojušies? Vai iespējams vēl glābt šī gada ražu?
latvia.description: Vasaras vidū raugoties uz ābelēm, šķiet, ka drīz varēs baudīt sulīgus, skaistus ābolus. Taču dažreiz pietiek tikai ar vienu dienu – un no kraukšķīgā, aromātiskā augļa paliek mīksts ābols ar brūniem plankumiem. Kāpēc āboli pūst vēl pirms tie ir nogatavojušies? Dārzkopības speciālisti uzsver, ka pietiek ar nelielu mikroplaisu – piemēram, no kukaiņa koduma vai putna […]

lithuania.description: Akkor egy 29 éves kormánytisztviselő sérült meg súlyosan, miután a kezében egy rossz mozdulat miatt a gránát túl hamar működésbe lépett.

lithuania.title: Atomtámadással fenyegetőzik Moszkva, titkos tárgyalások folynak Amerikában - Híreink az ukrajnai háborúról szerdán
lithuania.description: Lezuhant egy orosz Tu-95-ös hadászati bombázó az orosz Távol-Keleten, az incidens okait egyelőre viszgálják. Washingtoban nem bejelentett módon tárgyalnak az amerikaiak az oroszokkal, Kirill Dmitrijev főtárgyaló a városban van. Hajnalban súlyos támadás érte Kijevet: az ukrán főváros lángokban áll. A fronton az oroszok Dobropillját és Kosztyantynivkát szorongatják, Limanról az ukrán ellentámadásnak köszönhetően enyhült a nyomás. A nap folyamán Oroszország arról kezdett el kommunikálni, hogy Európa blokádolni akarja Kalinyingrádot, így atomtámadással is megfenyegették a NATO európai országait. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború szerdai eseményeivel.

lithuania.title: Bedurvultak az oroszok: ha Európa ezt tényleg megteszi, Moszkva indítja az atomfegyvereket
lithuania.description: Nukleáris fegyverekkel fog csapást mérni Oroszország, ha a NATO megpróbálja blokád alá vonni Kalinyingrádot – közölte Oroszország dublini nagykövetsége a Kyiv Independent cikke szerint.

lithuania.title: Bemondta az európai vezető: a NATO-nak minél hamarabb ukrán fegyverekre van szüksége
lithuania.description: Belgium számára az orosz légitámadások jelentik a legnagyobb biztonsági fenyegetést, ezért meg kell erősíteni a légvédelmi képességeket - jelentette ki Theo Francken belga védelmi miniszter szerdán Brüsszelben.

lithuania.title: Orosz támadás veszélye miatt leállítottak két NATO-repteret
lithuania.description: Átmenetileg leállították a forgalmat szerda reggel a lengyelországi Lublin és Rzeszów repülőterén a lengyel légierő műveletei miatt - közölte az X-en a lengyel légi közlekedési hatóság (PANSA).

lithuania.title: „Môžeme použiť jadrové zbrane.“ Kremeľ poslal Európe tvrdé varovanie kvôli Kaliningradu
lithuania.description: Ruskí diplomati pripomínajú Európe, že Rusko môže v prípade blokády Kaliningradskej oblasti odpovedať jadrovými zbraňami, uviedol dnes podľa ruskej štátnej agentúry TASS hovorca Kremľa Dmitrij Peskov.

lithuania.title: Na pomoc Pobaltí bychom v případě napadení museli vyslat dvě brigády, řekl Babiš
lithuania.description: Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) se v úterý po uložení korunovačních klenotů setkal s prezidentem Petrem Pavlem. Předseda vlády serveru Deník.cz řekl, že s hlavou státu diskutoval o programu příští Bezpečnostní rady státu, včetně možné reakce na případný ruský útok na některý z pobaltských států. „Pokud by nedej bože došlo k tomu, že by Rusko napadlo nějaký pobaltský stát, tak podle článku pět (NATO) musíme vyslat dvě naše mechanizované brigády,“ sdělil premiér.

lithuania.title: Senát schválil nižší počet vojáků bránící východní křídlo NATO
lithuania.description: Na obranu východního křídla NATO bude moci být v příštích dvou letech vysláno nejvýše 1600 českých vojáků, o 400 méně než dosud, schválil Senát. Horní komora parlamentu také na úvod svého středečního jednání vyslovila souhlas s ratifikací Úmluvy o zřízení Mezinárodní komise pro posuzování nároků Ukrajiny. Dále má na programu senátorské návrhy o nepromlčitelnosti trestného činu vraždy, o daňové úlevě pro dobrovolné hasiče a o ústavním zakotvení práva na život off-line.

lithuania.title: Estonsko obvinilo Rusko ze žhářského útoku na zbrojní firmu
lithuania.description: Estonsko uvedlo, že srpnový požár v tallinském zbrojním podniku Milrem Robotics byl způsoben žhářským útokem provedeným na rozkaz ruských tajných služeb. Informovala o tom stanice ERR. Firma dodává Ruskem napadené Ukrajině pozemní drony. Moskva podíl na požáru popřela. Generální tajemník NATO Mark Rutte prohlásil, že ruské hybridní útoky proti aliančním zemím neoslabí podporu Ukrajině.

lithuania.title: Un zbor Dubai-Tel Aviv a aterizat în Arabia Saudită după o alertă de deturnare. Oficial israelian: „Un pilot l-a înjunghiat pe altul”
lithuania.description: Un zbor Flydubai de la Dubai la Tel Aviv, cu 174 de pasageri la bord, dintre care 27 de copii, a aterizat miercuri în Arabia Saudită după ce o altercație fizică între piloți a declanșat un semnal de urgență care a stârnit inițial temeri privind o deturnare și a determinat Israelul să mobilizeze avioane de vânătoare, relatează ynetnews.com.

lithuania.title: Moscova a avertizat oficial NATO că va folosi armele nucleare dacă Alianța va încerca să izoleze o exclavă rusă
lithuania.description: Kremlinul a confirmat miercuri că Rusia a transmis avertismente de natură nucleară către NATO prin care atenţionează Alianţa cu privire la riscurile unei eventuale încercări de izolare a exclavei ruse Kaliningrad, pentru a le reaminti astfel „capetelor înfierbântate" din Europa dispoziţiile politicii Moscovei în cazul unor acţiuni de acest fel, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu: Orice sprijin pentru Ucraina trebuie condiționat. Sancțiunile asupra Rusiei sunt consecința etichetării ca stat agresor
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, a declarat miercuri, în direct la Digi24, că „orice sprijin trebuie să fie condiționat” în cazul Ucrainei și că partidul consideră Rusia „un stat agresor”. Peiu a precizat că AUR „nu își propune să schimbe aranjamentele internaționale ale României”.

lithuania.title: Cehia susține că ar fi gata să-și onoreze angajamentele față de NATO dacă Rusia atacă o țară baltică: „Desigur că ne pregătim”
lithuania.description: Republica Cehă ar fi pregătită să-și onoreze angajamentele față de NATO în cazul unui atac al Rusiei asupra unei țări baltice, a declarat marți prim-ministrul Andrej Babis pentru un site de știri ceh, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Rusia amenință Europa cu atacuri nucleare. În ce situație va folosi țara lui Putin focoasele strategice
lithuania.description: Rusia va recurge la toate mijloacele de care dispune, inclusiv cele nucleare, în cazul în care țările NATO vor încerca să blocheze regiunea Kaliningrad sau să o atace, a declarat Ambasada Federației Ruse în Marea Britanie.

lithuania.title: Tensiuni explozive la granița NATO. Alianța militară respinge avertismentul Rusiei privind Kaliningrad și promite autoapărare totală
lithuania.description: NATO a respins, marţi, cu fermitate, un avertisment venit din partea Moscovei privind o escaladare militară serioasă în jurul exclavei ruse Kaliningrad, informează DPA.

lithuania.title: Rutte: Rusia nu poate sparge unitatea NATO. Cum răspunde Alianța la atacurile cu drone și sabotajele hibride
lithuania.description: Rutte a afirmat că Rusia nu a reușit să zdruncine unitatea NATO, în ciuda actelor de sabotaj și a atacurilor cu drone. Alianța își consolidează apărarea și sprijinul acordat Ucrainei.

lithuania.title: CCR a decis că femeile asigurate pe cont propriu nu pot fi excluse de la concediul și indemnizația de risc maternal
lithuania.description: Curtea Constituțională a decis marți, cu unanimitate de voturi, că femeile asigurate pe cont propriu, printr-un contract încheiat cu casa de sănătate, nu pot fi excluse de la concediul și indemnizația de risc maternal doar pentru că nu au statutul de salariate. Judecătorii au stabilit că această diferență de tratament este discriminatorie și încalcă dreptul la ocrotirea sănătății și la un nivel de trai decent.

lithuania.title: Viceguvernator BNR: „Prelungirea crizei politice devine tot mai problematică. Revenirea la normalitate este esențială”
lithuania.description: România înregistrează „semne bune” în reducerea dezechilibrelor bugetare, progrese observate și de agențiile de rating, însă prelungirea crizei politice pune tot mai multe probleme, avertizează viceguvernatorul BNR Cosmin Marinescu. Acesta spune că revenirea la normalitate în planul guvernării este esențială pentru încrederea investitorilor și a mediului de afaceri.

lithuania.title: O dronă rusă a avariat un punct de frontieră ucrainean de la graniţa cu Polonia. Vămi închise temporar
lithuania.description: O dronă rusă cu motor cu reacţie a lovit luni satul ucrainean Starovoitove, situat lângă graniţa cu Polonia, avariind un punct de control la frontieră, a anunţat guvernatorul interimar al regiunii Volînia.

lithuania.title: Darryl Nirenberg, vizită la poligonul de instrucție Babadag: „România nu este singură. Statele Unite sunt aici și NATO este aici”
lithuania.description: Prezent la Babadag cu ocazia sosirii primelor vehicule amfibii de asalt AAV-7, ambasadorul Statelor Unite ale Americii în România, Darryl Nirenberg, a susținut că aceste vehicule sunt importante, dar și impresionante. Diplomatul este de părere că sosirea acestora reprezintă „un exemplu foarte bun” al parteneriatului dintre SUA și România, care va împlini anul viitor 30 de ani.

lithuania.title: Generalul NATO Alexus Grynkewich: De ce vrea Rusia să slăbească voința aliaților Ucrainei și ce riscă Europa
lithuania.description: Comandantul suprem al forţelor aliate în Europa (SACEUR), Alexus Grynkewich, le-a transmis luni eurodeputaţilor că obiectivul Moscovei este de a înfrânge dorinţa aliaţilor Ucrainei de a continua să sprijine această ţară în războiul său de apărare contra Rusiei, transmite Reuters.

lithuania.title: Proiectul privind alegerile anticipate, pus în dezbatere: se reduc unele termene şi numărul minim de susţinători necesar candidaților
lithuania.description: Autoritatea Electorală Permanentă (AEP) anunţă că proiectul de lege privind alegerile anticipate a fost pus în transparenţă. Instituția subliniază că proiectul nu pune în discuție posibilitatea organizării unui astfel de scrutin, ci urmărește ca, în eventualitatea în care acesta ar avea loc, procesul electoral să se desfășoare cu respectarea deplină a Constituției și a garanțiilor pe care legea le oferă fiecărui alegător, oriunde s-ar afla.
